heading: All pair coefficients must be assigned
patterns: All pair coeffs are not set
symptoms: Pair::init() aborts when the pair style has not allocated a coefficient table or when a required diagonal type pair has not been assigned.
suggested_actions: restore the intended framework force-field assignment and regenerate the LAMMPS input/settings files
use only force-field parameters supported by the selected model and file-backed or literature evidence
do not insert arbitrary generic pair coefficients merely to make the run start
text: The LAMMPS 3 Mar 2020 source emits this exact message in src/pair.cpp lines 233-236. It establishes that required pair coefficients are absent, but it does not identify which scientific force field the user intended. Model selection and parameter assignment therefore require input/model evidence beyond the error string.

heading: Cannot open molecule file
symptoms: The molecule command tried to open the named molecule-template file and fopen returned null.
suggested_actions: check the exact molecule filename and path against available files
restore or regenerate the intended guest molecule template instead of inventing topology or charges
when several guest models are possible, preserve force-field compatibility and require literature or user evidence before changing the model family
text: The LAMMPS 3 Mar 2020 source emits `Cannot open molecule file %s` in src/molecule.cpp lines 1627-1637. The molecule manual defines the command as `molecule ID file1 ...` and explains that the referenced files contain molecule descriptions.

heading: Unknown command in LAMMPS input
symptoms: The LAMMPS input parser could not dispatch the current input line to any registered command.
suggested_actions: use the reported last command and the input file to correct a typo or unsupported command
preserve the intended simulation operation; do not delete a valid physical operation solely to make the script runnable
verify corrected syntax against the matching LAMMPS command documentation
text: The LAMMPS 3 Mar 2020 source formats `Unknown command: %s` in src/input.cpp when execute_command() reports no matching command.
